app.name: ICEwhistle
app.description: Know your rights. Prepare your family. Stay connected with your community.

kyr.title: Know Your Rights
kyr.subtitle: Understanding your constitutional rights during encounters with immigration enforcement
kyr.disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice.

rights.remainSilent: You have the right to remain silent
rights.askWarrant: Ask if they have a warrant
rights.denyEntry: You do not have to let them in without a warrant
rights.recordEncounter: You have the right to record the encounter

warrant.title: Warrant Comparison
warrant.judicialDesc: Signed by a judge. You must comply.
warrant.administrativeDesc: Not signed by a judge. You do NOT have to open your door.

legal.title: Legal Support
legal.subtitle: Find immigration legal resources near you
legal.disclaimer: ICEwhistle connects you with legal resources but does not provide legal advice. Always consult with a qualified immigration attorney for legal matters.

panic.title: Emergency Alert
panic.activated: Emergency alert sent to your contacts

footer.disclaimer: ICEwhistle provides legal education, not legal advice.
